title: Systematic investigation on the segregation behavior of non-metallic atoms and their synergistic regulation mechanism of the hydrogen embrittlement at uranium grain boundaries
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,22048-22061
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01229A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Longxian Li, Min Zhu, Yan Li, Chengxuan Peng, Longfei Pu, Zijian Wang
As a core fuel material for nuclear reactors, the segregation of non-metallic impurities and the hydrogen embrittlement effect at the grain boundaries of metallic uranium pose a serious threat to the long-term service safety of fuel elements.
